title: Rugby Forward Training Plan
author: Christopher Jeffery
desc:
Training plan for rugby forwards. This is only part of the plan, specifically the strength training part. There are also days for endurance/cardio that are not included here.

THIS IS THE (FREE) IN-SEASON PLAN FROM RUCK SCIENCE. I AM NOT THE ACTUAL CREATOR OF THIS PLAN.
